name: HoliMont

source.note: Piste reference data — confirm at source. Approximate base-lodge position on NY-242 west of Ellicottville village.
Search summary (2026-09-30): 700 ft vertical (213 m). Base and summit elevations not found.
Search summary (2026-09-30): 55 trails, 135 skiable acres, 8 lifts = 6 chairlifts and 2 conveyors (stored as other). Another result in the same summary said "8 chairlifts".

character: A private ski club in Ellicottville, next door to Holiday Valley, with about 700 ft of vertical, 55 trails and 135 acres. The public can buy day tickets Monday to Friday; Saturdays and Sundays are for members and their guests only.
learning: Two conveyor lifts serve learning terrain (search summary). Lessons and rentals for the public were not researched — see the official FAQ.

season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Dec 12, 2026 (a third-party projection, not an announcement). Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived. Public skiing is weekdays only (Mon–Fri); weekends are members and guests only.

prices.note: Search summary (2026-09-30): weekday adult $100, junior (7-11) $80, adult half-day after 1 pm $90, children 6 and under free; 5-day pass $390, 10-day pass $575. Public tickets are sold Mon–Fri only. Season not stated, and a 2022-23 weekday brochure also appeared in the results, so these may be older rates. Confirm at source.
